evals.prompt: Check whether my knowledge base has broken links and fix them.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs a broad health check, diagnoses unresolved links with suggestions, safely edits only unambiguous cases using fresh hashes, and revalidates.
assertions: The first maintenance action is doctor
diagnose_notes is called with kinds containing only unresolved_link for the focused pass
include_suggestions is true
Each edited source note is read with content_hash before edit_note
Every edit_note call includes if_match_hash
Ambiguous suggestions are not selected automatically
The agent reruns diagnostics and doctor after repairs

evals.expected_output: The agent checks backlinks and a fresh content hash, warns about affected notes, and prefers trash deletion.
assertions: list_backlinks is called before delete_note
read_notes obtains content_hash before deletion
The agent warns when backlinks exist
hard_delete is false unless permanent deletion was explicitly confirmed
delete_note includes if_match_hash

evals.prompt: Search fails because the mnemonic index is invalid. Repair it.
evals.expected_output: The agent verifies the failure with doctor, rebuilds the index once, and runs doctor again without rewriting notes unless source diagnostics require it.
assertions: doctor runs before rebuild_index
rebuild_index is called once
doctor runs again after rebuilding
No source note is edited without a source-note diagnostic

evals.prompt: Fix the duplicate slug reported for my two deployment notes.
evals.expected_output: The agent inspects both notes and backlinks, chooses or requests a canonical identity, changes a noncanonical slug through merge_frontmatter with a fresh hash, updates inbound links, and revalidates.
assertions: Both colliding notes are read with content_hash
Backlinks are inspected before changing a slug
The slug change uses edit_note merge_frontmatter with a slug key
The slug change includes if_match_hash
The agent rechecks duplicate_slug and link diagnostics

evals.prompt: The doctor reports invalid frontmatter, and read_notes says the note is corrupted. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: The agent stops MCP mutation for the unparseable note and uses a backed-up raw-file repair workflow before synchronizing and revalidating.
assertions: The agent does not call edit_note on the corrupted unreadable note
The agent requires filesystem inspection of the diagnostic path
The raw file is backed up before editing
The repair preserves the body and mnemonic_note_id when recoverable
The agent synchronizes or reindexes and reruns doctor afterward
